attributes.board_name: Arkansas Board of Animal Health (veterinary licensing)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs by accredited/approved veterinary colleges, AAHA, AVMA and its recognized specialty organizations, local/state/regional/national veterinary associations, NAVTA and its specialty academies, AAVSB RACE, or USDA; others by Board pre-approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE waived for the renewal period in which the veterinarian graduated and was licensed.
rules.alternatives: Board may exempt or extend for sickness or other justifiable reason; no CE for inactive renewal.
rules.audit_note: Keep records 3 years; Board may audit.
rules.notes: Hours earned April 1 - March 31. Min. 10 h medicine and surgery; max 8 h nonscientific; max 2 h colleague visitation; max 2 h exhibit halls. At least 10 h in person or live interactive webinar; max 10 h prerecorded/non-interactive online.
